scientific_role: Simulator-based M1 integration method. The first implementation step lifts each public I1 provider card into the simplest native single-provider AICon/YAFS surrogate that is compatible with the exposed information, before any graph-level white-box evaluation is consulted.

allowed: already-frozen public rho-conditioned I1 provider cards
public composition graph G when the later composition step is executed
fixed M1 closure conventions declared in this contract
forbidden: fitted GMM parameters or private GMM samples
Phase-1 graph-level white-box sigma outcomes during lifting
retuning I1 or M0 to improve M1

lift_definition: L_M1: I1_i -> theta_i^M1, with W_i actively determining the arrival process used during local inverse calibration.

pilot_scope.rule: For this pilot only, Q is fixed rather than optimized because every public A_i has q_min=0.5 and the public card contains no quality diversity.
pilot_scope.generalization_warning: This is not a general M1 assumption. Beyond the pilot, non-degenerate Q requires an explicit QoS-generating surrogate and q_i(rho_region) may vary with the admissibility region.

fixed_closure_conventions.arrival_process: periodic with period and accounting origin read from W_i
fixed_closure_conventions.arrival_phase: canonical YAFS periodic source convention: first provider-local arrival occurs one period after accounting origin, then at integer multiples of the period; the current public W_i does not expose an additional phase parameter
fixed_closure_conventions.canonical_IPT_role: numerical gauge only; not interpreted as recovered provider hardware
fixed_closure_conventions.networking_during_local_lift: Provider-local calibration uses a dedicated workload-injector node and provider node because AICon enforces at most one application module per device. They are connected by a native link with PR=0 and requests have bytes=0, so the adapter contributes zero network delay.
fixed_closure_conventions.local_latency: provider arrival to provider completion including queue waiting and native service; the zero-delay injector-to-provider adapter contributes no network latency
fixed_closure_conventions.local_cost: native COST(node)*service for the provider module only

public_target_construction.source: full public query-rho survival slice sigma_i(A_i(rho_region),H;rho_query)
public_target_construction.interpretation: At fixed A_i and H, rho_query -> sigma is the sampled survival function of the random cumulative compliance fraction c_i(A_i,H).
public_target_construction.crossing_rule: Infer a median compliance target where sigma crosses 0.5. Use linear interpolation between adjacent exposed rho_query points when the crossing is bracketed.
public_target_construction.low_side_censoring: If sigma at the smallest exposed rho_query is below 0.5, the median is upper-censored below that rho value.
public_target_construction.high_side_censoring: If sigma at the largest exposed rho_query is at least 0.5, the median is lower-censored at or above that rho value.

stage1_deterministic_nominal_lift.loss: uniform mean squared point/hinge loss over all public A_i(rho_region) and H>0 targets; point targets use squared error, lower/upper censored targets use one-sided squared hinge loss

optimization.cost_rate_reference: median over public regions of c_max/max(l_max,1e-12)
optimization.boundary_rule: If the best candidate remains on a search boundary after refinement, do not freeze the lift; extend the relevant bound using public-I1 reconstruction only.

stage2_stochastic_variability_lift.service_distribution: Gamma with the Stage-1 mean and fitted coefficient of variation; CV=0 is interpreted as deterministic service
stage2_stochastic_variability_lift.fit_target: the full public rho-conditioned I1 sigma surface over all A_i(rho_region), H>0, and exposed rho_query values
stage2_stochastic_variability_lift.loss: uniform mean squared error between simulated sigma_hat and public I1 sigma_hat

optimization.boundary_rule: If the best CV remains on the upper search boundary after refinement, do not freeze the lift; extend the CV range using local I1 reconstruction only.

pilot_surrogate: theta_i^M1=(mu_i,kappa_i,CV_i), with W_i, canonical IPT, x_i=0.5, and the QoS mapping fixed.
stage_separation: Stage 2 fits only CV. It does not silently re-optimize mu or kappa. Any later joint-refinement variant requires a new declared M1 revision.
whitebox_firewall: The complete provider lift is frozen from public I1 reconstruction diagnostics before graph-level white-box sigma is read for M1 evaluation.

beyond_pilot.quality_diversity: Introduce non-degenerate provider quality through a native quality/resource trade-off rather than independent noise. A natural first extension is a varying execution fraction x, for which Q and executed work are coupled.
beyond_pilot.general_region: A_i(rho_region)={L_i<=l_i(rho_region), C_i<=c_i(rho_region), Q_i>=q_i(rho_region)} with q_i allowed to vary.
beyond_pilot.workload_diversity: Exercise multiple W_i contracts and topologies that induce different provider-local arrival processes. A surrogate lifted under one W_i is not assumed valid under an unsupported W_i'.
beyond_pilot.graph_diversity: After the pilot, evaluate sequential, parallel, nested, conditional/dependent, and heterogeneous-provider compositions while preserving the same public-information firewall.

freeze_rule: This file defines an implementation candidate, not a frozen M1 result. Freeze only after simulator-independent tests, native single-provider smoke tests, and provider-local I1 reconstruction diagnostics pass without graph-level white-box tuning.
